game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Wind Pass, a howling mountain pass: the summit pilot must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Case Choir: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune.
theme: Frost Peaks – Wind Pass: a howling mountain pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Wind Pass, repeat each round: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the choir value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the cliff anchor using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The cliff anchor reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the cliff anchor is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 6 (applied tier): Case Choir
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Case Choir' (Week 8 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Wind Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how choir changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Wind Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The cliff anchor reached with actions_used <= 17.
